description: This file defines a Go package 'services' that provides a UI service for managing and retrieving execution data, including filtering, grouping, and real-time event broadcasting for workflow executions. It primarily offers data structures and methods for UI display, filtering, grouping, and SSE client management, interfacing with storage components and handling execution events.

classes.name: ExecutionsUIService
classes.description: Service handling retrieval, filtering, grouping, and real-time updates of workflow executions for UI consumption.

methods.name: NewExecutionsUIService
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of ExecutionsUIService with provided storage backend.

methods.name: GetExecutionsSummary
methods.description: Retrieves paginated execution summaries based on filters and grouping options.

methods.name: GetGroupedExecutions
methods.description: Retrieves grouped execution summaries by specified attribute with pagination.

methods.name: GetExecutionDetails
methods.description: Fetches detailed information for a particular execution ID from storage.

methods.name: RegisterClient
methods.description: Registers a new SSE client channel for real-time execution events.

methods.name: DeregisterClient
methods.description: Deregisters an SSE client channel and closes it.

methods.name: BroadcastExecutionEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts a specified execution event to all registered SSE clients.

methods.name: OnExecutionStarted
methods.description: Handler to broadcast a start event for an execution.

methods.name: OnExecutionCompleted
methods.description: Handler to broadcast a completion event for an execution.

methods.name: OnExecutionFailed
methods.description: Handler to broadcast a failure event for an execution.
